title: Teams, Zoom & meetings
blurb: Can't hear or be heard, camera off, screen share, Teams won't start.

remedies.title: Files in Teams won't open or sync
remedies.why: Teams files live in SharePoint; the desktop app link or your SharePoint access is failing.

steps.text: Choose Open in browser to check access first.
Sign in to Office desktop apps with the same work account.
Use "Add shortcut to My files" to work with them through OneDrive.

remedies.title: Teams uses lots of memory or makes the computer slow
remedies.why: Teams is a heavy app, worse with many chats, video effects and GPU problems.

steps.text: Turn off video effects and incoming video when not needed.
Quit Teams when not needed and use Teams on the web for quick checks.

remedies.title: Meeting links open in the browser instead of the app
remedies.why: The browser hasn't been allowed to open the app, or the app isn't the default for its links.

steps.text: On the join page click Open Microsoft Teams / Launch Meeting and tick "Always allow".
Set Teams as the default for msteams links.

remedies.title: I'm hosting a meeting: muting people, removing someone, breakout rooms
remedies.why: Organisers have extra controls in the meeting.

steps.text: Teams: People › ⋯ › Mute all / Remove; Meeting options › Who can bypass the lobby; Rooms for breakouts.
Zoom: Participants › Mute All / Remove; Breakout Rooms button (enable in web settings first).

remedies.title: Teams or Zoom calls drop or reconnect
remedies.why: Short network outages, a sleeping laptop, or VPN switching.

steps.text: Use a cable or stay near the router.
Turn off "Wi-Fi power saving" (see Wi-Fi keeps dropping).
Join without VPN if your organisation allows it for meetings.
